subject: Request: evidence package for recent security fixes and controls pack
messages:
From: Alex Reed <alex.reed@fincorp.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: security@fincorp.com
Date: 2026-07-10T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Request: evidence package for recent security fixes and controls pack

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the high-level remediation note from the engineering team. As part of our security validation I need an evidence package that demonstrates the fixes were applied to production and the compensating controls we put in place. Specifically, could you provide: 

- Screenshots showing the fix in production (relevant UI or admin consoles)
- Config snippets (nginx/ingress, service-level feature flags) that show the vulnerable setting changed
- Links to the internal tickets or Jira items that tracked the fix (including PR/merge links)
- Audit-log exports covering the deployment window and the action that fixed the issue (timestamped)
- A short write-up of compensating controls (monitoring, alerting, WAF rules) and how they mitigate recurrence

Also please include a mapping to any SOC 2 controls this touches (if you can). Our compliance team needs the package by EOD July 14 so we can close our SOW item. If you prefer a secure upload (SFTP/Share) instead of email attachments, let me know.

Thanks,
Alex Reed
Security Operations
FinCorp
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Reed <alex.reed@fincorp.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-10T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: evidence package for recent security fixes and controls pack

Alex — thanks for the list. We're on it and will assemble a single evidence package. Planned deliverables and timeline: 

- Today (07/10): confirm which artifacts are available and whether any need redaction.
- 07/11: provide preliminary artifacts (screenshots.zip + config-snippets.txt) and Jira links.
- 07/12: export audit logs and S3 listing screenshot; final controls summary and SOC 2 mapping.

Attachments I will prepare: fix-screenshots.zip (screenshots), config-snippets.txt (sanitized), INF-4321.loglink.txt (Jira links). If you need the files transmitted to SFTP, we can provide a temporary account; otherwise I will attach redacted files to this thread.

Cc'ing Markus (platform) and Dylan (SRE) to pull logs and config snippets. Markus — can you confirm last deploy timestamp and whether the fix was backported to the regional clusters? Also include the PR/merge and ticket IDs.

If FinCorp requires encrypted transfer, tell me which method you prefer.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive — Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Alex Reed <alex.reed@fincorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-11T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: evidence package for recent security fixes and controls pack

Alex — pulling the artifacts together now. Quick answers and links below.

Deployment / tickets:
- Fix deployed to prod: 2026-07-09T03:22:14Z (can provide CI/CD run id).
- Jira tickets: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4321 (root fix), https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4322 (backport to eu cluster).
- PR/merge: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/987 (merged 2026-07-09).

Attachments included (sanitized):
- config-snippets.txt — relevant lines below (sanitized):
  upstream_service_timeout: 30s
  allow_legacy_auth: false  # changed from true -> false to close the vector
  ingress.rules: |-
    - host: api.redwood.com
      path: /v1/
      rewrite: /v1/

- fix-screenshots.zip — screenshots showing updated admin toggles and feature flags (prod view).

Compensating controls (summary):
- WAF rule set updated: added signature for CVE-XXXX-YYYY and rate-limit on the affected endpoint.
- Monitoring: a New Relic alert (ID NR-5588) on 5xx spike + anomalous payload size triggered during validation window.
- Audit trail: all config changes recorded via GitOps (immutable commits + CI signature) and stored in S3 (versioned).

Note on immutability: commits are signed; S3 bucket has object versioning and MFA-delete enabled for the bucket containing deployment artifacts. We will supply an export of the audit log for 07/08–07/11.

--

From: Alex Reed <alex.reed@fincorp.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, security@fincorp.com
Date: 2026-07-11T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: evidence package for recent security fixes and controls pack

Thanks Markus — that is helpful. A couple quick follow-ups before we mark the item resolved: 

1) For the audit-log export, can you provide evidence that the logs for the deployment window (2026-07-09 02:00Z through 2026-07-09 06:00Z) were ingested to the central logging system and are immutable? A small CSV export is fine, plus a screenshot of the storage (S3 listing) showing object versioning.

2) For the GitOps immutability claim, can you provide the commit hash and a signed commit or CI artifact that ties the PR to the deployed image digest?

3) Finally, please confirm whether the backport to EU cluster was automatic or manual and whether it was included in the same release window.

If you can get those artifacts by EOD July 12 that would be ideal.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — FinCorp compliance wants to close the item this week.

Alex
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Reed <alex.reed@fincorp.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: evidence package for recent security fixes and controls pack

Alex — sending the final artifacts as requested. Attached to this message (and uploaded to our secure share) are: 

- audit-log-export.csv (rows include timestamp, user, action, request_id) — covers 2026-07-08 through 2026-07-11. Hash: sha256:3a7f...9b2c (see INF-4321.loglink.txt for signed artifact).
- s3-listing-screenshot.png — shows the bucket with versioning enabled and the object for the deployment artifact (version id visible).
- INF-4321.loglink.txt — contains the Jira ticket and link to the signed CI artifact tying the commit hash to the image digest (commit: a1b2c3d4, image: redwood/inference@sha256:ff12...).
- config-snippets.txt and fix-screenshots.zip (sanitized).

Backport note: the EU backport (INF-4322) was applied manually during the same maintenance window (2026-07-09T05:45:00Z) and the ticket reflects the manual approval and verification steps.

We will also upload a consolidated PDF controls summary and the SOC 2 mapping to the secure Drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c_controls_summary (shared with your security team). If you need file-level encryption or prefer SFTP instead of Drive, let me know and we can create a time-limited SFTP account for secure transfer.

If the artifacts look good to FinCorp, tell us and we'll mark the remediation item as closed.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive — Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
